confirmedFindings: 89 affected baseline items: 83 normalized matches marked mismatch plus 6 extraction artifacts; the other 38 of 127 reconciled rows are normalized matches with allergen evidence accurately unavailable. All 127 rows are reconciled uniquely, with no duplicate reconciled keys.
The official site links the location-specific Toast catalog, establishing Toast as a restaurant-linked vendor and confirming restaurant identity at 900 N Glebe Road, Arlington, Virginia.

The official food page exposes multiple menu contexts, while Toast exposes regular, summer, and substantially broader catering sections. The multi-service and non-exact-reconciliation risks are therefore valid.

The count-drift risk is valid as a warning: 127 frozen rows cannot be compared directly with the 84-item official-page parse because the frozen set includes multiple services, alternate presentations, headings, and modifiers.
The frozen catalog contains six non-product artifacts: Build Your Own Pizza, Burger Platters, Choice of Side: Skinny Fries, Sandwich, Slice, and Specialty Pizza.

Current unmatched products remain material. Toast explicitly lists Meatball Alla Vodka Pizza, Daily Special, and catering platters, hot dishes, sides, cookies, and brownies absent from the frozen product boundary.
No reopened primary source supplies a complete allergen matrix or cross-contact policy. Empty arrays cannot establish allergen absence or no cross-contact.

Restaurant-issued and restaurant-linked descriptions still support narrow positive evidence where they explicitly name cheese, dairy, egg, salmon, shrimp, bread, pasta, or another unavoidable allergenic identity. Those positives must not be erased merely because the overall menu is incomplete.
The upstream cross-contact gate is not affirmative cross-contact evidence. It supports only an unknown/unresolved status because no source provides shared-equipment or cross-contact language.
SpotApps remained inaccessible during independent reopening and cannot establish menu completeness or allergen conclusions.
